A '''Security Systems Tool Kit''', commonly known simply as a '''security tool kit''', was a [[Tool kit/Legends|tool kit]] intended to help an individual to perform repairs on security systems. They were readily available for sale throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], although the sale of Security Systems Tool Kits was restricted with either local or [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] licenses required before purchasing them. The kit generally cost 200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to purchase.<ref name="SWS" />
